en.question: Claude is asked for JSON and reliably returns it wrapped in a markdown code fence with a sentence of preamble. What is the cleanest fix?

options.text: Strip the fence and preamble with a regular expression after every call.
options.note: Works until the format varies slightly; it treats the symptom and stays brittle.

options.text: Instruct the model more forcefully to emit no markdown and no preamble.
options.note: Compliance is probabilistic, so a defensive parse is still required.

options.text: Define a tool matching the target shape and read its arguments directly.
Set temperature to 0 so the response format stops varying between calls.
options.note: Determinism does not guarantee the absence of a code fence.

en.explanation: A tool schema turns a formatting request into a typed contract, so you stop scraping prose for JSON and remove the entire class of problem rather than patching its symptom.
